card.name: Words before a required level or interval
card.fires_on: Small words like "to", "every", "kept" or "least" that come just before a threshold, a repeat interval, or a level to be held. Seen in dosing schedules, screening intervals, wage and poverty-level talk, and temperature limits.

modes.label: Repeat interval
modes.description: "every" after "once" or "at least once", before a number of weeks or months.

card.writes: It suppresses words about maintaining or holding a certain level, such as "maintained", "minimum" and "足够的", so the model is steered away from those continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a time interval or a level that must be met, like "once every" or "kept below".
